Type: rug
Name: Rivet Modern Gust Swirled Rug, 5' x 8', Grey
Colors: Multi-colours
Materials: rug
100% Polyester Imported Get lost in the hypnotizing swirls of this soft, yet durable, area rug. Its neutral tones of gray and white allow it to blend effortlessly with your existing décor. Intricate swirled design Textured, raised patterns Low, 0.2" pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 5' x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
